methodSections.heading: Radicchio Slaw
steps: Julienne the carrots and finely chop the lettuce.
Combine the carrots and lettuce in a bowl with olive oil and lemon. Add salt and pepper to taste.

methodSections.heading: Prawns
steps: In a fry-pan, heat canola oil until hot. Add prawns and sauté on both sides for 30 seconds each.

Add the garlic, chillies, wine, diced tomatoes and lemon, keeping the pan on the heat until the liquid has reduced by around half, creating a sauce. Add the butter and once melted, finish the sauce with the chopped parsley and remove the pan from the heat.
In a bowl, combine the carrot and lettuce salad with the prawns and sauce. Plate the salad with 6 prawns per serving as a main dish.
